original_authority_questions.question: What counts as the tenant's 'demand' under 33-1321(D) (e.g. a forwarding address or move-out notice), and does the 14-day clock run without one?
Does 33-1370(B) forfeiture relieve the landlord of the 33-1321(D) itemized list for any balance above accrued rent and costs?
What conduct is 'bad faith' under 1950.5(h)(7) and (m), and does a good-faith late statement forfeit the right to deduct (Granberry v. Islay Investments line)?

Is a former tenant's unpaid rent or move-out balance owed to a landlord a 'consumer credit transaction' debt under 1788.2(e)-(f), making the landlord or its manager a 'debt collector' when it collects in its own name?

Is a property manager (Holland Residential) collecting former residents' balances for an unaffiliated owner a 'collection agency' under 5-16-103 ('regularly collects ... debts owed ... another'), or excluded as activity 'incidental to a bona fide fiduciary obligation' (5-16-103 (b)(VI)(A))?

Is a residential tenant's move-out balance 'consumer debt' under RCW 6.01.060 (RCW 6.01.060 not yet saved), fixing judgment interest at 9 percent?
Does RCW 19.52.010 supply prejudgment interest on a liquidated move-out balance, and from what date?
